title: Robotic Strawberry Harvesting with Robust Vision and Deep Reinforcement Learning based Sim-to-Real Control
summary: This study presents a closed-loop robotic strawberry harvesting system that combines a robust vision module, simulation-trained deep reinforcement learning (DRL) control, and ROS-based realrobot execution. For perception, we propose HRAttnEdge-YOLO26-seg, a modified YOLO26-seg architecture that incorporates a high-resolution P2 branch, segmentation-path attention, and edgesupervised prototype learning to improve instance segmentation in cluttered scenes. For control, we train a target-conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy in Isaac Lab to produce smooth joint-position commands for a UR10e manipulator and deploy it on a UR10e robot for targetfruit reaching and harvesting. This simulation-based approach reduces hardware dependency, lowers development cost, and allows scalable policy training without exhaustive physical trials before real deployment. The proposed vision model demonstrated the highest overall performance among the evaluated methods. On both self-collected and public datasets, the model showed a 10 to 14% improvement in segmentation performance. In controlled in-house tests, the PPO controller produced stable and dynamically smoother motion than a inverse kinematics (IK)-based MoveIt baseline. In greenhouse trials, the proposed integrated system harvested 281 strawberries, achieving 96.6% reaching success, 91.3% grasp-and-pull success, and 84.3% overall harvesting success. These results illustrate that task-specific perception combined with simulation-trained PPO can serve as a practical and resource-efficient alternative to conventional planner-dependent reaching in manipulation, enabling reliable closed-loop robotic harvesting in complex agricultural environments.
tldr: This paper presents a closed-loop robotic strawberry harvesting system that combines an improved instance segmentation model (HRAttnEdge-YOLO26-seg) with a simulation-trained PPO policy deployed on a real UR10e manipulator, achieving high success rates in greenhouse trials.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种闭环的机器人草莓采摘系统，结合改进的实例分割模型（HRAttnEdge-YOLO26-seg）和基于模拟训练的PPO策略，部署在实际UR10e机械臂上，在温室实验中取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种闭环机器人草莓采摘系统，该系统集成了稳健的视觉模块、基于仿真训练的深度强化学习(DRL)控制策略以及基于ROS的真实机器人执行系统。在感知方面，我们提出了HRAttnEdge-YOLO26-seg模型，该模型改进了YOLO26-seg架构，通过引入高分辨率P2分支、分割路径注意力机制以及边缘监督原型学习，提升了杂乱场景下的实例分割性能。在控制方面，我们在Isaac Lab仿真环境中训练了一个目标条件化近端策略优化(PPO)策略，用于生成UR10e机械臂的平滑关节位置指令，并将其部署至真实UR10e机器人上，实现目标果实的接近与采摘。这种基于仿真的方法降低了硬件依赖性与开发成本，并允许在实际部署前进行可扩展的策略训练，无需开展大量物理实验。在所评估的方法中，所提出的视觉模型展现了最优的整体性能。在自建数据集和公开数据集上，该模型的分割性能提升了10%至14%。在受控室内测试中，PPO控制器产生的运动相比基于逆运动学(IK)的MoveIt基线方法更稳定且动态更平滑。在温室实验中，该集成系统成功采摘了281颗草莓，实现了96.6%的接近成功率、91.3%的抓取与拉拽成功率，以及84.3%的整体采摘成功率。这些结果表明，任务特定的感知模块与基于仿真训练的PPO相结合，可作为传统依赖规划器实现接近操作的一种实用且资源高效的替代方案，从而在复杂农业环境中实现可靠的闭环机器人采摘。

title: Point Tracking Improves World Action Models
summary: Robot policy learning benefits from world-action models that capture environment dynamics, but pixel-level prediction entangles dynamics with nuisance factors such as lighting and texture, making learned representations vulnerable to task-irrelevant visual variation. We propose JOPAT, a JOint Pixel-And-Track World-Action Model that predicts latent visual observations, 2D point tracks with visibility, and actions in a single denoising diffusion transformer. The key insight is that tracks provide an explicit representation of motion that captures long-horizon dynamics and remains robust under occlusion or partial out-of-frame motion, offering greater utility than modeling pixel appearance alone. On LIBERO and real-world LeRobot tasks, JOPAT improves over pixel-based baselines, with the largest gains on long-horizon tasks involving occlusion, object interaction, and off-screen motion.
tldr: JOPAT proposes a joint pixel-and-track world-action model that adds 2D point tracking to a diffusion transformer for robot policy learning, improving robustness to occlusion and off-screen motion on long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: JOPAT提出了一种联合像素与轨迹的世界行动模型，通过将2D点追踪加入扩散变换器，提高了机器人在长期任务中对遮挡和屏幕外运动的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 机器人策略学习受益于捕捉环境动态的世界-动作模型，但像素级预测会将动态信息与光照、纹理等干扰因素纠缠在一起，导致学到的表示易受与任务无关的视觉变化影响。我们提出JOPAT，一种联合像素与轨迹的世界-动作模型，该模型在单个去噪扩散变换器中预测潜在视觉观测值、带可见性的二维点轨迹以及动作。关键洞见在于：轨迹提供了运动的显式表示，可捕捉长时域动态并在遮挡或部分离帧运动下保持鲁棒性，其效用远超仅建模像素外观。在LIBERO和真实世界的LeRobot任务中，JOPAT相较于基于像素的基线方法表现更优，在涉及遮挡、物体交互及屏幕外运动的长时域任务中提升最为显著。

title: Instrumentation for Imitation Learning: Enhancing Training Datasets for Clothes Hanger Insertion
summary: Large behaviour models have transformed the field of robotic manipulation, but prohibitive data requirements have thus far prevented a revolution similar to vision language models. We believe that instrumentation, i.e. sensor integration in objects, can provide invaluable state information and enable efficient learning for robotic manipulation. In this paper, we present instrumented imitation learning of clothes hanger insertion. Using 180 teleoperated demonstrations, we train diffusion policies with and without access to instrumentation data. Results show that policies leveraging instrumentation outperform vision-only counterparts by 14-25 %pt and exhibit greater task awareness. Crucially, a black-box imitation learning policy learns to prioritise instrumentation signals without explicit guidance. In addition, enhancing the teleoperation dataset with rollouts from an instrumented expert policy, enables a vision-only student policy to achieve performance comparable to the instrumented expert, thereby surpassing the original vision-only policy. These findings establish instrumentation as a promising strategy to enhance imitation learning for robotic manipulation. Datasets are available on Zenodo.
tldr: This paper proposes instrumented imitation learning, where sensor-integrated objects provide state information to enhance training of diffusion policies for clothes hanger insertion, demonstrating significant performance gains over vision-only baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种仪器化模仿学习方法，通过在物体中集成传感器来提供状态信息，增强衣物挂架插入任务的扩散策略训练，实验表明该方法显著优于纯视觉基线。
summary_zh: 大型行为模型已彻底改变了机器人操作领域，然而迄今为止，极高的数据需求阻碍了类似视觉语言模型那样革命的实现。我们认为，仪器化——即在物体中集成传感器——能够提供宝贵的状态信息，并实现机器人操作的高效学习。本文提出了针对衣架插入任务的仪器化模仿学习。通过使用180次远程操作演示，我们训练了有无仪器化数据接入的扩散策略。结果表明，利用仪器化数据的策略在任务表现上比纯视觉策略高出14–25个百分点，并展现出更强的任务感知能力。关键在于，黑箱模仿学习策略能够在没有显式引导的情况下自主优先处理仪器化信号。此外，通过使用仪器化专家策略的展开数据增强远程操作数据集，纯视觉学生策略能够达到与仪器化专家策略相当的性能，从而超越原有的纯视觉策略。这些发现确立了仪器化作为增强机器人操作模仿学习的一种有前景的策略。数据集可在Zenodo上获取。

title: Direct Dynamic Retargeting for Humanoid Imitation Learning from Videos
summary: Imitation Learning from monocular video demonstrations provides a scalable approach for teaching complex skills to humanoid robots. However, translating human motion to humanoids requires overcoming significant morphological mismatches. Standard approaches rely on Geometric Retargeting or Indirect Dynamic Retargeting pipelines. We identify that these intermediate kinematic projections introduce a geometric bias, restricting the search space and yielding suboptimal dynamic behaviors. In this paper, we propose Direct Dynamic Retargeting (DDR), a novel single-stage framework that generates high-fidelity, dynamically feasible trajectories directly from expert videos. By formulating the problem in the task space and leveraging a sampling-based Model Predictive Control solver within a physics simulator, DDR natively optimizes over complex contact sequences while mitigating input drift. Our experiments demonstrate that bypassing the geometric bias allows DDR to outperform state-of-the-art baselines in demonstration tracking accuracy. Furthermore, we establish that providing such physically viable references to RL agents accelerates training convergence and enhances the final execution of agile and balancing behaviors. Source code will be made publicly available.
tldr: This paper proposes Direct Dynamic Retargeting (DDR), a single-stage framework that directly generates dynamically feasible humanoid trajectories from monocular video demonstrations, bypassing geometric bias inherent in standard retargeting pipelines and improving imitation learning performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出直接动态重定向（DDR），一种单阶段框架，直接从单目视频演示生成动态可行的人形机器人轨迹，绕开标准重定向流程中固有的几何偏差，提升模仿学习性能。
summary_zh: 从单目视频演示中进行模仿学习，为向人形机器人传授复杂技能提供了一种可扩展的方法。然而，将人类运动迁移至人形机器人需要克服显著的形态学差异。标准方法依赖于几何重定向或间接动态重定向流程。我们发现，这些中间运动学投影引入了几何偏差，限制了搜索空间并产生了次优的动态行为。本文提出直接动态重定向（DDR），这是一种新颖的单阶段框架，可直接从专家视频生成高保真、动态可行的轨迹。通过在任务空间中构建问题，并在物理仿真器中利用基于采样的模型预测控制求解器，DDR 能够在缓解输入漂移的同时，原生地优化复杂的接触序列。实验表明，绕过几何偏差使得 DDR 在演示跟踪精度上优于当前最先进的基线方法。此外，我们证实，为强化学习智能体提供此类物理上可行的参考，能够加速训练收敛，并提升敏捷与平衡行为的最终执行效果。源代码将公开发布。

title: Any2Any: Efficient Cross-Embodiment Transfer for Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking
summary: Whole-body tracking (WBT) models have become a key foundation for humanoid robots, enabling them to imitate diverse motions with high fidelity. Training such models from scratch requires large-scale data and computation, making rapid deployment on new humanoid platforms costly. This raises a natural question: Can pretrained WBT models transfer across embodiments with minimal adaptation? To answer this question, we propose Any2Any, a paradigm that efficiently transfers an existing WBT specialist to a new humanoid embodiment with only a small amount of data and compute. Any2Any first performs kinematic alignment between source and target humanoids, aligning their input and output spaces so that the pretrained source policy can be meaningfully reused on the target embodiment.Any2Any then performs dynamics adaptation by applying lightweight parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) components to selected dynamics-sensitive modules, preserving useful behavioral priors while enabling targeted adaptation to the target robot. Extensive experiments on multiple humanoid platforms and pretrained backbones show that Any2Any substantially accelerates convergence and reduces training cost compared with training from scratch, while achieving competitive or superior tracking performance. Notably, using only 1% of the compute and data required for full training, Any2Any successfully transfers Sonic models pre-trained on Unitree G1 to LimX Oli and LimX Luna. These results suggest that pretrained WBT specialists can be efficiently reused across embodiments, providing a scalable path toward deploying humanoid whole-body control on new robots.
tldr: Any2Any proposes a kinematic alignment and parameter-efficient fine-tuning paradigm for transferring pretrained whole-body tracking models across different humanoid robots with minimal data and compute.
tldr_zh: Any2Any 提出了一种运动学对齐与参数高效微调范式，能够以极小的数据和计算代价将预训练全身跟踪模型跨实体迁移至不同人形机器人。
summary_zh: 全身跟踪（WBT）模型已成为人形机器人的关键基础技术，使其能够高保真地模仿多样化动作。从头训练此类模型需要大规模数据和计算资源，这导致在新人形平台上快速部署成本高昂。这自然引发了一个问题：预训练的WBT模型能否通过极少的适配在不同实体间迁移？为回答该问题，我们提出Any2Any范式——仅需少量数据和计算资源，即可将现有WBT专家高效迁移至新的人形实体。Any2Any首先对源实体与目标实体进行运动学对齐，通过统一其输入输出空间，使得预训练源策略能够在目标实体上被有效复用。随后，Any2Any通过向选定的动力学敏感模块施加轻量级参数高效微调组件，进行动力学适配，在保留有用行为先验的同时实现针对目标机器人的定向适应。在多人形平台与预训练骨干网络上的大量实验表明，相比从头训练，Any2Any显著加速收敛并降低训练成本，同时取得具有竞争力甚至更优的跟踪性能。值得注意的是，仅使用完整训练所需1%的计算与数据量，Any2Any便成功将在宇树G1上预训练的Sonic模型迁移至灵心Oli与灵心Luna。这些结果表明，预训练的WBT专家可跨实体高效复用，为在新机器人上部署人形全身控制提供了一条可扩展路径。

title: Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts for Compositional Robotic Manipulation
summary: Diffusion-based policies have established a new standard for precise robotic manipulation but face a critical scalability bottleneck: high-performance models are computationally expensive, while lightweight alternatives often fail to generalize across diverse multi-task environments. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures offer a promising path to efficiency by activating only a subset of parameters. However, existing MoE routing mechanisms typically rely on low-level noise or latent statistics, ignoring the compositional nature of manipulation tasks. This can fragment reusable behaviors across experts, limiting interpretability and transferability. We introduce Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Policy (SMoDP) for compositional robotic manipulation, a framework that grounds expert specialization in semantic task structure. SMoDP leverages a lightweight, inference-time skill predictor, supervised by offline annotations from Vision-Language Models (VLMs), to route action chunks to experts specialized for specific behavioral phases. To ensure robust assignment, we propose a dual contrastive alignment strategy that grounds multi-modal observations in language-defined skill semantics (Inter-modal) while enforcing routing consistency across visually distinct but functionally related behaviors (Intra-modal). Our approach outperforms representative diffusion and MoE-based baselines on multi-task benchmarks with significantly improved parameter efficiency and demonstrates effective compositional transfer to novel tasks through parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Project website: https://deng-cy20.github.io/SMoDP/
tldr: SMoDP grounds expert specialization in semantic task structure via a lightweight skill predictor supervised by VLM annotations, enabling parameter-efficient compositional robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: SMoDP通过轻量级技能预测器（由VLM标注监督）将专家专业化建立在语义任务结构上，实现了参数高效的组合式机器人操作。
summary_zh: 基于扩散的策略为精准机器人操控设立了新标准，但面临关键的可扩展性瓶颈：高性能模型计算成本高昂，而轻量级替代方案往往难以在多样化的多任务环境中泛化。混合专家架构通过仅激活部分参数，为提升效率提供了有前景的路径。然而，现有混合专家路由机制通常依赖低级噪声或潜在统计量，忽略了操控任务的组合特性，这可能导致可复用行为在专家间分散，限制了解释性和可迁移性。我们提出面向组合式机器人操控的语义结构化混合专家扩散策略（SMoDP），该框架将专家专长锚定于语义任务结构。SMoDP利用轻量级推理时技能预测器（通过视觉-语言模型的离线标注进行监督），将动作块路由至专精于特定行为阶段的专家。为确保鲁棒的分配，我们提出双重对比对齐策略：一方面在语言定义的技能语义中定位多模态观测（模态间对齐），另一方面强制视觉不同但功能相关的行为保持路由一致性（模态内对齐）。我们的方法在多任务基准测试中优于代表性扩散策略和基于混合专家的基线模型，参数效率显著提升，并通过参数高效微调展现出向新任务的有效组合迁移能力。项目网站：https://deng-cy20.github.io/SMoDP/

title: ChainFlow-VLA: Causal Flow Planning with Vision-Language Models
summary: Current end-to-end autonomous driving systems are fundamentally limited by a mismatch between temporal causal reasoning and global trajectory consistency. Autoregressive (AR) models capture interaction-aware temporal dependencies via causal factorization, but their step-wise decoding leads to error accumulation and suboptimal global structure. In contrast, diffusion models optimize trajectories globally but lack explicit causal constraints, making them unreliable in interactive and safety-critical scenarios. This dichotomy reveals a deeper issue: existing methods treat causal modeling and global optimization as separate paradigms, without a principled way to unify them within a single trajectory distribution. To address this, we propose ChainFlow-VLA, which unifies causal generation and global refinement within a unified probabilistic framework. We formulate planning as a mixture over AR-induced modes and learn Vision-Language Model (VLM)-conditioned residual distributions over these modes. An autoregressive generator (Chain) produces a discrete set of causal trajectory modes, followed by a diffusion-based refiner (Flow) that leverages VLM hidden states as semantic priors to perform mode-conditioned correction in residual space while preserving causal structure. This straightforward conditioning seamlessly injects high-level scene understanding into fine-grained trajectory adjustments. Experiments demonstrate that ChainFlow-VLA achieves robust planning in ambiguous and long-tail scenarios, achieving a state-of-the-art score of 94.85 on the NAVSIM v1 leaderboard, matching human-level performance (94.8). Code will be available at https://github.com/AFARI-Research/ChainFlow-VLA.
tldr: ChainFlow-VLA unifies autoregressive causal planning with diffusion-based global refinement under VLM conditioning, achieving state-of-the-art autonomous driving results on NAVSIM v1.
tldr_zh: ChainFlow-VLA将自回归因果规划与基于扩散的全局优化统一在VLM条件框架下，在NAVSIM v1上实现了自动驾驶的领先性能。
summary_zh: 当前端到端自动驾驶系统在时序因果推理与全局轨迹一致性之间存在根本性不匹配。自回归模型通过因果分解捕捉交互感知的时序依赖关系，但其逐步解码方式会导致误差累积及全局结构次优。相比之下，扩散模型虽能优化全局轨迹，但缺乏显式因果约束，在交互密集及安全关键场景中可靠性不足。这种二元对立揭示了更深层问题：现有方法将因果建模与全局优化视为独立范式，缺乏在单一轨迹分布中统一两者的原则性途径。为此，我们提出ChainFlow-VLA，在统一概率框架下融合因果生成与全局精化。我们将规划问题表述为自回归诱导模态的混合分布，并学习以视觉-语言模型（VLM）状态为条件的残差分布。自回归生成器（Chain）生成离散因果轨迹模态集，随后基于扩散的精化器（Flow）以VLM隐藏状态作为语义先验，在保持因果结构的同时对残差空间进行模态条件校正。这种简洁的条件注入方式将高层场景理解无缝融入细粒度轨迹调整。实验表明，ChainFlow-VLA在模糊及长尾场景中实现了鲁棒规划，在NAVSIM v1排行榜上取得94.85的当前最优分数，与人类水平（94.8）相当。代码将开源至https://github.com/AFARI-Research/ChainFlow-VLA。

title: Turning Adaptation into Assets: Cross-Domain Bridging for Online Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Navigating under non-stationary environment shifts poses a critical challenge for a Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) agent deployed in the wild. Yet, existing Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) methods for VLN largely treat online adaptation as transient, isolated updates, leading to catastrophic forgetting and negative transfer. To overcome these issues, we propose Inter-Domain BridgE with Historical Assets (IDEA), a novel TTA framework that transforms adaptation into the accumulation and composition of assets. Specifically, IDEA introduces soft prompts optimized via a Fisher-guided weighting scheme to capture the transferable knowledge. These optimized prompts are then augmented with domain coordinates to form a dynamic asset library. Leveraging this library, IDEA constructs a cross-domain bridge by projecting the target domain onto the convex hull of historical knowledge. These designs form a complementary loop: the evolving library underpins bridge construction, while the bridge provides superior initialization to accelerate asset optimization. Extensive experiments across REVERIE, R2R, and R2R-CE benchmarks demonstrate the consistent superiority of IDEA over existing methods, showcasing its ability to enable training-free adaptation via asset sharing.
tldr: Proposes IDEA, a test-time adaptation framework for Vision-Language Navigation that turns adaptation into accumulation and composition of cross-domain prompts, enabling training-free adaptation via asset sharing.
tldr_zh: 提出IDEA，一种用于视觉语言导航的测试时自适应框架，将自适应转化为跨域提示的积累与组合，通过资产共享实现无需训练的适应。
summary_zh: 在非平稳环境变化下的导航对部署于真实场景的视觉-语言导航（VLN）智能体构成了严峻挑战。然而，现有的VLN测试时自适应（TTA）方法大多将在线自适应视为短暂、孤立的更新过程，导致灾难性遗忘和负迁移。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于历史资产的域间桥梁（IDEA）框架——一种将自适应转化为资产积累与组合的新型TTA方法。具体而言，IDEA引入了通过Fisher引导加权方案优化的软提示，以捕获可迁移知识。这些优化后的提示与域坐标相结合，形成动态资产库。利用该资产库，IDEA通过将目标域投影到历史知识的凸包上构建跨域桥梁。这些设计形成了互补循环：不断演化的资产库支撑桥梁构建，而桥梁则提供更优的初始化以加速资产优化。在REVERIE、R2R和R2R-CE基准上的大量实验表明，IDEA始终优于现有方法，展现了其通过资产共享实现免训练自适应能力。

title: IntentionNav: A Benchmark for Intent-Driven Object Navigation from Implicit Human Instruction
summary: Existing object navigation benchmarks usually tell an embodied agent which object category to find, such as microwave or chair. Human-facing embodied AI is often asked something less direct: "I need something to warm this food" or "the room feels stuffy." The agent must infer the object that can satisfy the need, find a scene-grounded instance, and decide whether the goal has been reached. We study this setting as intent-driven object navigation and introduce IntentionNav, a diagnostic benchmark for active object search from implicit human instructions. Each episode provides a free-text intent, RGB-D observations, and pose, but withholds the target object name. IntentionNav contains 500 intents over 176 Isaac Sim scenes and 64 target categories. Each intent is rewritten in four controlled instruction styles and annotated with one of four intent modes, separating surface phrasing from semantic cue type under matched geometry. This paired design supports analysis of target inference, language robustness, neighborhood reachability, and terminal success rather than only aggregate success. We evaluated three VLMs using a fixed active-navigation agent. Models identify the intended target in 48.3 percent of episodes and enter its 2 m neighborhood in 68.7 percent, but terminate successfully in only 24.9 percent and achieve grounded 1 m success in 5.5 percent. Success is highest for event-script intents (28.7 percent) and lower for physical-state and affordance intents (19.2 percent and 18.5 percent), showing that indirect human intent remains a bottleneck for target selection, visual verification, and terminal localization in active embodied search.
tldr: This paper introduces IntentionNav, a benchmark for object navigation where agents must infer a target object from implicit human instructions, and evaluates VLMs on this task, finding low success rates due to challenges in target inference and verification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了IntentionNav，一个从隐含人类指令中推断目标物体的物体导航基准，并评估了VLM在此任务上的表现，发现由于目标推断和验证的挑战，成功率较低。
summary_zh: 现有物体导航基准测试通常指示具身智能体查找特定物体类别（例如微波炉或椅子）。而面向人类的具身人工智能常被赋予更间接的任务：“我需要加热食物”或“房间很闷”。智能体必须推断出满足需求的物体，找到场景中可依托的实例，并判断是否已完成目标。我们将此场景定义为意图驱动的物体导航，并引入IntentionNav——一个面向隐式人类指令的主动物体搜索诊断基准测试。每个测试轮次提供自由文本意图、RGB-D观测数据及位姿信息，但隐去目标物体名称。IntentionNav包含176个Isaac Sim场景中的500条意图，覆盖64个目标类别。每条意图以四种受控指令风格改写，并标注四种意图模式之一，在几何条件匹配的前提下分离表层措辞与语义线索类型。这种配对设计支持对目标推断、语言鲁棒性、邻域可达性及终端成功率的分析，而非仅关注总体成功率。我们采用固定主动导航智能体评估了三种视觉语言模型。模型在48.3%的轮次中识别出预期目标，68.7%的轮次进入目标2米邻域，但仅24.9%的轮次成功终止，5.5%的轮次实现1米范围内的地面真值成功。事件脚本类意图的成功率最高（28.7%），物理状态与可供性类意图的成功率较低（分别为19.2%和18.5%），这表明间接人类意图仍是主动具身搜索中目标选择、视觉验证与终端定位的瓶颈。

title: $π_0$-EqM: Equilibrium Matching for Closed-Loop Vision-Language-Action Control
summary: Currently, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become the most adopted paradigm for robotic manipulation for its great potential for task generalization. While most generative flow-matching action decoders for VLA control are often deployed with fixed sampling horizons, limiting state-dependent compute and temporal reuse across control cycles. We present $π_0$-EqM, which replaces the flow-matching expert in $π_0$ with an Equilibrium Matching (EqM) decoder while leaving the upstream VLA stack unchanged. Under a matched 300-step budget, $π_0$-EqM improves RoboTwin average success from 40.4% to 50.2% across 19 tasks and remains competitive on LIBERO, with its clearest gain on LIBERO-10 (87.0%). Two threshold scans reveal a task-dependent non-monotonic relation between residual and success, which we term the stationarity--executability gap. The results suggest that inference depth in iterative VLA control is part of policy design and introduce an energy-based VLA perspective that may inform future work on composable action generation across tasks and embodiments.
tldr: This paper proposes replacing the flow-matching action decoder in the π0 VLA model with an Equilibrium Matching (EqM) decoder, achieving improved success rates on robotic manipulation benchmarks by enabling variable inference depth.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出用平衡匹配解码器替换π0 VLA模型中的流匹配动作解码器，通过实现可变推理深度在机器人操作基准上提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 目前，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型因其在任务泛化方面的巨大潜力，已成为机器人操作领域最主流的范式。然而，用于VLA控制的大多数生成式流匹配动作解码器通常采用固定的采样步长，这限制了状态相关的计算能力和跨控制周期的时间复用。我们提出了$π_0$-EqM，该方法在不改变上游VLA堆栈的前提下，用均衡匹配（EqM）解码器替换了$π_0$中的流匹配专家。在匹配的300步计算预算下，$π_0$-EqM在19个任务中将RoboTwin的平均成功率从40.4%提升至50.2%，并在LIBERO基准测试中保持竞争力，其中在LIBERO-10上取得了最显著的提升（87.0%）。两次阈值扫描揭示了残差与成功率之间存在任务依赖的非单调关系，我们将其称为平稳性-可执行性差距。研究结果表明，迭代式VLA控制中的推理深度属于策略设计的一部分，并引入了一种基于能量的VLA视角，这可能为未来跨任务与跨具身的可组合动作生成研究提供启示。

title: RS2AD-LiDAR: End-to-End Autonomous Driving LiDAR Data Generation from Roadside Sensor Observations
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving solutions, which directly process multimodal sensory data and output fine-grained control commands, have gradually become a mainstream direction with the development of autonomous driving technology. However, current methods in this category rely on single-vehicle data collection for model training and optimization, which suffers from high acquisition and annotation costs, scarcity of valuable scenarios, and data silos. To address these challenges, we propose RS2AD-LiDAR, a novel framework for reconstructing and generating vehicle-mounted LiDAR data from roadside sensor observations. Since no public dataset currently provides highly overlapping perception coverage between roadside and vehicle-mounted LiDAR sensors, which is essential for studying roadside-to-vehicle data generation, we constructed a dedicated dataset named R2V-LiDAR which is used solely for evaluation in this work. Specifically, our method transforms roadside LiDAR point clouds into the vehicle-mounted LiDAR coordinate system, and synthesizes high-fidelity vehicle-mounted data via virtual LiDAR modeling and point cloud resampling techniques. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first approach to reconstruct vehicle-mounted LiDAR data from roadside sensor inputs. Extensive experimental comparisons demonstrate the semantic similarity between the generated data and real data. Furthermore, object detection experiments show that incorporating the generated data into real data for model training improves both Bird's Eye View (BEV) and 3D detection accuracy, thereby validating the effectiveness of the proposed method.
tldr: Proposes a framework to generate vehicle-mounted LiDAR data from roadside sensor observations to augment training data for autonomous driving, demonstrating improved detection accuracy.
tldr_zh: 提出一种从路边传感器观测生成车载激光雷达数据的框架，以增强自动驾驶训练数据，并验证了检测精度的提升。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶方案直接处理多模态感知数据并输出细粒度控制指令，随着自动驾驶技术的发展已逐渐成为主流方向。然而，当前该类方法依赖单车数据采集进行模型训练与优化，存在采集标注成本高、价值场景稀缺及数据孤岛等问题。针对上述挑战，我们提出RS2AD-LiDAR这一新颖框架，能够从路侧传感器观测数据中重建并生成车载激光雷达数据。由于当前公开数据集均未提供路侧与车载激光雷达传感器间具有高度重叠感知覆盖范围的数据（这对于研究路侧到车载数据生成至关重要），我们专门构建了名为R2V-LiDAR的数据集，该数据集仅用于本工作的评估。具体而言，本方法通过将路侧激光雷达点云变换至车载激光雷达坐标系，并借助虚拟激光雷达建模与点云重采样技术合成高保真车载数据。据我们所知，这是首个从路侧传感器输入重建车载激光雷达数据的方法。大量实验对比表明，生成数据与真实数据在语义层面具有高度相似性。此外，目标检测实验证实，将生成数据融入真实数据进行模型训练，可同时提升鸟瞰图与三维检测精度，从而验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: DRIVESPATIAL: A Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Intelligence in VLMs for Autonomous Driving
summary: Spatiotemporal intelligence in autonomous driving (AD) requires an agent to integrate multi-view observations into a coherent scene representation, maintain object continuity across viewpoints and time, and reason about spatial relations, interactions, and future dynamics. However, existing AD vision-language benchmarks largely focus on single-view, static, ego-centric, or single-source question answering, leaving it unclear whether current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can truly construct and reason over dynamic driving scenes. We introduce DriveSpatial, a benchmark of 15.6K human-verified QA pairs across 20 tasks from five large-scale AD datasets. DriveSpatial evaluates four abilities: Cognitive Scene Construction, Multi-view Relational Understanding, Temporal Reasoning, and Generalization. Unlike prior benchmarks, DriveSpatial is generated from a dynamic multi-relational scene graph that encodes object states, spatial relations, interactions, camera visibility, and temporal correspondences, enabling QA pairs that enforce genuine cross-view and spatiotemporal reasoning. Evaluating 15 representative VLMs reveals a substantial human-model gap: the strongest model trails humans by 28.4 points, with Cognitive Scene Construction emerging as the key bottleneck. Further diagnostics show that language-only prompting is insufficient, while explicit BEV grounding consistently improves performance. These results suggest that current VLMs lack the scene-construction ability needed for reliable spatiotemporal driving intelligence. DriveSpatial and its construction pipeline will be released to support future research.
tldr: DriveSpatial is a benchmark with 15.6K human-verified QA pairs across 20 tasks to evaluate spatiotemporal reasoning of VLMs in autonomous driving, revealing a 28.4-point gap between the best model and humans and identifying cognitive scene construction as a key bottleneck.
tldr_zh: DriveSpatial 是一个包含15.6K人工验证的问答对和20个任务的基准，用于评估自动驾驶视觉语言模型的时空推理能力，揭示了最佳模型与人类之间28.4分的差距，并指出认知场景构建是关键瓶颈。
summary_zh: 自主驾驶中的时空智能要求智能体将多视角观测整合为一致的场景表征，维持目标在跨视角与时间维度上的连续性，并推理空间关系、交互作用及未来动态。然而，现有自主驾驶视觉-语言基准测试主要集中于单视角、静态、自我中心或单源问答，难以判断当前视觉-语言模型是否真正具备对动态驾驶场景的构建与推理能力。我们提出DriveSpatial基准，包含来自五个大规模自主驾驶数据集的20项任务中的1.56万个人工验证问答对。该基准评估四项能力：认知场景构建、多视角关系理解、时序推理与泛化能力。与现有基准不同，DriveSpatial基于动态多关系场景图生成，该图编码目标状态、空间关系、交互关系、相机可见性及时序对应关系，从而生成强制要求跨视角与时空推理的问答对。对15个代表性视觉-语言模型的评估揭示了显著的人机差距：最强模型落后人类28.4个百分点，其中认知场景构建成为关键瓶颈。进一步诊断表明，仅语言提示不足，而显式鸟瞰图引导可持续提升性能。这些结果表明，当前视觉-语言模型缺乏实现可靠时空驾驶智能所需的场景构建能力。DriveSpatial及其构建流程将开源以支持未来研究。

title: WMAttack: Automated Attack Search for Adversarial Evaluation of World-Model Agents
summary: Despite the growing use of world models as decision-making agents, their adversarial robustness remains underexplored due to the lack of dedicated automated evaluation methods. A key obstacle is that attack evaluation must be both accurate and efficient: weak manually tuned attacks can overestimate robustness, while exhaustive hyperparameter search is prohibitively expensive because each candidate requires closed-loop rollouts through learned latent dynamics. We introduce WMAttack, an automated attack-search framework for adversarial evaluation of world-model agents. WMAttack formulates robustness evaluation as a finite-budget search over attack configurations, including attack families, perturbation budgets, optimization steps, restarts, and allocation rules. To improve search accuracy, Self-Correcting Attack Search (SCAS) refines the attack proposal distribution using feedback from reward degradation, action instability, runtime cost, and rollout variability. To improve search efficiency, Representation-Guided Attack Retrieval (RGAR) retrieves effective historical configurations from representation-similar tasks, providing a warm start for unseen environments. We provide a theoretical explanation showing that proposal refinement improves finite-budget search when it shifts probability mass toward high-utility attacks. Across Atari and DeepMind Control tasks, WMAttack consistently discovers stronger attacks than the evaluated baselines, improving normalized reward drop from 0.497 to 1.034 on DreamerV3 Atari and from 0.319 to 0.682 on DMC. Ablations further show that RGAR improves initial candidate quality and SCAS improves final attack utility under fixed evaluation budgets.
tldr: This paper proposes WMAttack, an automated framework for adversarial robustness evaluation of world-model agents, using self-correcting attack search and representation-guided retrieval to efficiently find strong attack configurations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了WMAttack，一个用于世界模型代理对抗鲁棒性评估的自动化框架，通过自我修正攻击搜索和表征引导检索高效地发现强大的攻击配置。
summary_zh: 尽管世界模型作为决策智能体的应用日益广泛，但其对抗鲁棒性因缺乏专用自动化评估方法而仍未被充分探索。主要障碍在于攻击评估必须兼具准确性与高效性：人工调参的弱攻击可能高估鲁棒性，而穷举超参数搜索代价过高，因为每个候选方案都需要通过学习的潜在动力学进行闭环展开测试。我们提出WMAttack——一种用于世界模型智能体对抗评估的自动化攻击搜索框架。该框架将鲁棒性评估形式化为有限预算下的攻击配置搜索，涵盖攻击类型、扰动预算、优化步数、重启次数及分配规则。为提升搜索精度，自校正攻击搜索（SCAS）通过奖励衰减、动作不稳定性、运行时开销及展开变异性的反馈来优化攻击提议分布；为提升搜索效率，表征引导攻击检索（RGAR）从表征相似任务中检索有效历史配置，为未知环境提供热启动。理论分析表明，当提议优化将概率质量向高效攻击转移时，可提升有限预算搜索性能。在Atari和DeepMind Control任务上，WMAttack始终能发现比基线更强的攻击：DreamerV3 Atari任务中归一化奖励下降从0.497提升至1.034，DMC任务中从0.319提升至0.682。消融实验进一步表明，在固定评估预算下，RGAR提升了初始候选质量，SCAS提升了最终攻击效用。

title: TactileReflex: Noise-Statistics-Driven Vision-Tactile Reflex Control for Force-Sensitive Manipulation
summary: Manipulating fragile deformable containers, such as disposable plastic cups filled with liquid, demands real-time grip-force adaptation within an extremely narrow force margin: insufficient force causes slip, while excessive force irreversibly deforms the thin wall. Existing approaches struggle to achieve such force-sensitive manipulation tasks. We propose a noise-statistics-based calibration-driven reflex control paradigm with vision-based tactile sensing: by analyzing the sensor's intrinsic noise characteristics (via a brief static-hold-and-unload protocol), we directly derive all controller thresholds, eliminating external force calibration, trial-and-error manual tuning, or material-specific physical models. Instantiating this paradigm, we present TactileReflex, a three-channel closed-loop controller that extracts three image-level proxies, shear intensity ($S_y$), contact intensity ($F_n$), and center of pressure ($C$), from dual visuo-tactile sensors and drives prioritized reflex channels at ~12 Hz for slip suppression, weight-adaptive release, and force protection. Each channel closes the loop directly on its proxy via noise-derived thresholds. Ablation demonstrates that only the full three-channel system is able to prevent irreversible container deformation (5/5 success vs. at most 1/5 for partial configurations). In a dynamic pouring task, fixed-effort baselines fail in all 10 attempts due to pose drift, while TactileReflex achieves 9/10 success across two water volumes. As a self-contained and interpretable controller, TactileReflex can serve as a plug-and-play safety layer beneath high-level manipulation pipelines, including haptic-free VR teleoperation and vision-language-action (VLA) policies.
tldr: A noise-statistics-driven reflex controller using vision-based tactile sensing for force-sensitive manipulation of fragile deformable containers, demonstrated on real robots.
tldr_zh: 一种基于噪声统计学的视觉触觉反射控制器，用于易变形容器的力敏操作，在真实机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 摘要：操控易碎的可变形容器（例如装有液体的一次性塑料杯），需要在极窄的力阈值范围内实现实时抓握力自适应调节：抓力不足会导致滑动，而抓力过大会不可逆地使薄壁变形。现有方法难以实现此类力敏操控任务。我们提出了一种基于噪声统计的标定驱动反射控制范式，结合视觉触觉传感技术：通过分析传感器的固有噪声特性（借助简短的静态保持-卸载协议），可直接推导出所有控制器阈值，从而无需外部力标定、人工试错调参或材料特定的物理模型。基于该范式，我们实现了TactileReflex——一种三通道闭环控制器，它从双视觉触觉传感器中提取三个图像级代理变量：剪切强度（$S_y$）、接触强度（$F_n$）和压力中心（$C$），并以约12 Hz的速率驱动优先级反射通道，实现滑动抑制、重量自适应释放和力保护。每个通道通过基于噪声导出的阈值直接在其代理变量上闭合控制回路。消融实验表明，仅当三个通道全部启用时，才能防止容器发生不可逆变形（完全配置成功率为5/5，而部分配置最高仅1/5）。在执行动态倾倒任务时，固定力度的基线方法因姿态漂移导致10次尝试全部失败，而TactileReflex在两种水量下均实现了9/10的成功率。作为一种自完备且可解释的控制器，TactileReflex可作为即插即用的安全层，集成于高级操控流程（包括无触觉VR远程操控及视觉-语言-动作策略）中。

title: Sparse Compositional Flow Matching by geometric assembly from motion primitives
summary: Embodied trajectories, such as the executable motion sequences of robotic manipulators, underwater vehicles, and mobile robots, are a fundamental output of embodied AI. Modern generative models often treat them as a dense, monolithic signal generated point by point, fitting an intricate high-dimensional posterior while leaving the data's latent structure unmodeled, the same sample inefficiency long identified by the structured generative model literature. We argue that a compositional latent structure is a natural choice: many embodied tasks share recurring motion fragments that can be made explicit as a finite repertoire of reusable motion primitives, and compositional units naturally align with subtask boundaries to support task decomposition. Existing compositional generators, however, compose in a latent space and rely on post-hoc decoding to relate sampled units to actual trajectory segments. We instead compose directly in the physical trajectory space through a flow-matching framework with two coupled designs. Motion-Primitive Dictionary Learning equips each atom with a learnable length mask and binary starting indicators so the atom itself is the primitive, reused verbatim wherever it is placed. Structural Sparse Flow Matching with Geometric Constraints then generates a binary placement matrix using duration-aware tokenization and a differentiable geometric loss that enforces spatial continuity and temporal contiguity where adjacent primitives meet. On Open X-Embodiment and 3DMoTraj, the framework attains state-of-the-art accuracy and reduces the FDE/ADE ratio from 1.8 to 1.07, improving ADE by 19.2% and FDE by 21.0% over the strongest baseline.
tldr: This paper proposes a compositional flow-matching framework that generates embodied trajectories by assembling reusable motion primitives directly in physical space, improving accuracy on robot and vehicle trajectory benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种组合流匹配框架，通过在物理空间中直接组装可复用的运动基元来生成具身轨迹，在机器人和车辆轨迹基准上提升了准确性。
summary_zh: 具身轨迹（例如机械臂、水下航行器及移动机器人的可执行运动序列）是具身智能的基础输出形式。现代生成模型通常将其视为逐点生成的致密单模态信号，在拟合复杂高维后验分布的同时，忽略了数据中潜在的隐结构——这正是结构化生成模型领域早已指出的样本效率瓶颈。我们认为，组合式隐结构是自然的选择：众多具身任务共享可复现的运动片段，这些片段可显式构建为有限的可复用运动基元库，而组合单元天然与子任务边界对齐以支持任务分解。然而，现有组合式生成器在隐空间进行组合，需依赖事后解码将采样单元关联至实际轨迹片段。我们提出通过流匹配框架直接在物理轨迹空间进行组合，该框架包含两个耦合设计：运动基元字典学习为每个原子配备可学习的长度掩码与二元起始指示符，使原子本身即为基元，在任意部署位置逐字复用；结合几何约束的结构化稀疏流匹配通过时长感知分词化与可微几何损失函数生成二元放置矩阵，该损失函数强制相邻基元衔接处的空间连续性与时间邻接性。在Open X-Embodiment与3DMoTraj数据集上，本框架达到最先进精度，将FDE/ADE比值从1.8降至1.07，相较于最强基线，ADE提升19.2%，FDE提升21.0%。

title: Autonomous Frontier-Based Exploration with VLM Guidance
summary: Autonomous robotic exploration of unknown and hazardous environments, a long-standing challenge, can be significantly improved by leveraging the advanced reasoning of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). We introduce a novel exploration pipeline where a VLM performs high-level strategic decision-making, guiding a conventional low-level robotics control stack. At decision points, the robot generates a multimodal prompt with its current map and visual imagery of potential paths, or frontiers. The VLM analyzes this prompt to select the most promising frontier, replacing simple geometric heuristics with contextual spatial reasoning. This approach, validated in simulation across six indoor environments, improves map coverage by up to 24\% over existing methods. Our pipeline is lightweight, training-free, and easily transferable to any robot with standard sensors and an internet connection.
tldr: The paper proposes an exploration pipeline that uses a VLM to select exploration frontiers based on contextual reasoning, improving map coverage in simulated indoor environments.
tldr_zh: 论文提出了一个利用VLM进行上下文推理来选择探索前沿的自主探索流程，在仿真室内环境中提高了地图覆盖率。
summary_zh: 自主机器人对未知与危险环境的探索是一个长期挑战，而视觉-语言模型（VLM）的先进推理能力可显著提升这一过程。我们提出了一种新型探索流程：由VLM执行高层战略决策，引导传统的低层机器人控制栈。在决策节点上，机器人会生成包含当前地图与潜在路径（即前沿区域）视觉图像的多模态提示。VLM通过分析该提示选择最具潜力的前沿区域，以基于上下文的空间推理替代简单的几何启发式方法。该方法在六个室内环境的仿真验证中，相较于现有技术将地图覆盖率提升高达24%。本流程轻量化、无需训练，且可轻松迁移至任何配备标准传感器与网络连接的机器人。

title: Semantic-Aware Guided Drone Exploration for Language-Conditioned 3D Indoor Mapping
summary: We present Semantic-Aware Guided Exploration, SAGE, a system for open-vocabulary exploration in unknown 3D indoor environments that preserves coverage-oriented behavior while allowing semantic cues to reprioritize frontier selection. Building on the FALCON volumetric explorer, SAGE integrates Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) via four key components: object-centric embedding storage, a temporal cache that projects recent observations onto the free-unknown boundary, object frontiers for high-similarity detections, and a unified semantic-geometric planning cost. This cost function bounds semantic reweighting influence, ensuring frontiers are prioritized without sacrificing total coverage. In Matterport3D-based simulations, SAGE outperforms FALCON and a semantic-only ablation in object discovery across map-query pairs. Compared to Finding Things in the Unknown (FTU), SAGE completes exploration 9.0 to 25.9 times faster across the nine shared map-query pairs, achieving a mean speedup of 13.7. Furthermore, SAGE achieves substantially higher volumetric throughput than FTU. Finally, we deploy SAGE in five real-world flights in two environments on a Modal AI Starling 2 quadrotor with onboard sensing and planning, and offboard CLIP inference. Comparing SAGE and FALCON, we find that while FALCON results in faster exploration and shorter mapping trajectories, SAGE outperforms FALCON in terms of object discovery.
tldr: SAGE integrates CLIP into a volumetric explorer for open-vocabulary, language-conditioned 3D indoor mapping with a drone, demonstrating faster object discovery in simulation and real-world flights.
tldr_zh: SAGE 将 CLIP 集成到体积探索器中，用于无人机在未知室内环境中的开放词汇、语言条件 3D 建图，在仿真和真实飞行中实现了更快的物体发现。
summary_zh: 我们提出语义感知引导探索系统SAGE，该方案可在未知三维室内环境中实现开放词汇探索，在保留覆盖导向行为的同时，允许语义线索重新优先化前沿选择。基于FALCON体积探索器框架，SAGE通过四个关键组件整合对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）模型：以对象为中心的嵌入存储模块、将近期观测投影至自由-未知边界的时序缓存模块、面向高相似度检测的对象前沿模块，以及统一的语义-几何规划代价函数。该代价函数通过约束语义重加权影响幅度，确保在不牺牲总覆盖率的条件下实现前沿优先化。在基于Matterport3D的仿真实验中，SAGE在地图-查询对的目标发现任务中均优于FALCON及纯语义消融模型。与未知环境目标发现（FTU）方法相比，SAGE在九个共享地图-查询对上的探索速度提升9.0至25.9倍，平均加速比达13.7。此外，SAGE的体积通量显著高于FTU。最终，我们在Modal AI Starling 2四旋翼飞行器上部署SAGE系统，在两种真实环境的五次飞行测试中均采用机载感知与规划模块及离板CLIP推理。通过对比SAGE与FALCON的性能发现：FALCON虽能实现更快的探索速度与更短的地图构建轨迹，但SAGE在目标发现任务中表现更优。

title: PIMbot: A Self-Adaptive Attack Framework for Adversarial Manipulation of Multi-Robot Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent research has demonstrated the potential of reinforcement learning in effective multi-robot collaboration, particularly in social dilemmas where robots face a trade-off between self-interest and collective benefits. However, environmental factors such as miscommunication and adversarial robots can impact cooperation, making it crucial to explore how multi-robot communication can be manipulated to achieve different outcomes. This paper presents PIMbot, a framework that manipulates outcomes via two complementary levers: (i) incentive manipulation of the reward channel and (ii) policy manipulation of an agent's own actions. An adaptive multi-objective controller balances these levers in an online manner. Our work introduces a novel approach to manipulation in recent multi-agent RL social dilemmas that utilize a unique reward function for incentivization. By utilizing our proposed PIMbot mechanisms, a robot is able to manipulate the social dilemma environment effectively. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed methods in the Gazebo-simulated multi-robot environment. Moreover, a real embedded device case study on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano quantifies system cost and validates PIMbot's effectiveness on realistic autonomous embedded systems scenarios beyond simulation. Together, these results position PIMbot as a rigorous stress-test tool exposing critical vulnerabilities in multi-robot cooperative tasks.
tldr: PIMbot is a self-adaptive adversarial attack framework that manipulates multi-robot reinforcement learning through reward and policy manipulation, serving as a stress-test tool for cooperative multi-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: PIMbot 是一个自适应对抗攻击框架，通过奖励和策略操控来干扰多机器人强化学习，作为多机器人协作任务的压力测试工具。
summary_zh: 近年来研究已证实强化学习在多机器人有效协作中的潜力，特别是在机器人需权衡个体利益与集体利益的社会困境场景中。然而环境因素（如通信故障与对抗性机器人）可能影响协作效果，因此探究如何操纵多机器人通信以实现不同结果至关重要。本文提出PIMbot框架，通过两个互补杠杆操纵结果：（i）奖励通道的激励操纵；（ii）智能体自身行为的策略操纵。自适应多目标控制器以在线方式平衡这两个杠杆。本研究针对近期采用独特奖励函数进行激励的多智能体强化学习社会困境，提出了一种新颖的操纵方法。通过运用所提出的PIMbot机制，机器人能有效操纵社会困境环境。综合实验结果表明，该方法在Gazebo仿真多机器人环境中具有有效性。此外，基于NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano的真实嵌入式设备案例研究量化了系统成本，并验证了PIMbot在超越仿真环境的真实自主嵌入式系统场景中的有效性。这些成果共同确立了PIMbot作为严格压力测试工具的地位，可揭示多机器人协作任务中的关键漏洞。

title: Robots That Know What to Ask: Recovering Misaligned Rewards through Targeted Explanations
summary: Learning reward functions from demonstrations assumes that demonstrations provide adequate supervision over all features -- or task-relevant aspects of behavior. In practice, demonstrations are often imperfect: humans may under-emphasize certain features due to cognitive load or physical difficulty, or the training regime may fail to sufficiently cover all relevant situations. In either case, important features may be underspecified, leading to ambiguity in the learned reward function and misaligned behavior at deployment. We propose a framework that detects such underspecified features and actively solicits targeted corrective demonstrations. Our key insight is that demonstrations implicitly reveal which features are well specified: features that are consistently optimized show little variation across demonstrations, while features that are underspecified vary widely. We leverage this statistical signal to infer which features may have been insufficiently demonstrated. The robot then explains which features it is uncertain about in natural language and queries for demonstrations that explicitly address the identified gaps. We evaluate our approach in a simulated tabletop manipulation domain and in a user study with a real Franka robot. Targeted, explanation-guided queries significantly improve reward recovery compared to random querying and passive data collection, reducing ambiguity that would otherwise persist in learning from imperfect demonstrations.
tldr: Proposes a framework where robots detect underspecified reward features from demonstration variance, then query humans for targeted corrective demonstrations via natural language explanations to improve reward recovery.
tldr_zh: 提出一个框架，机器人通过演示方差检测未充分指定的奖励特征，然后通过自然语言解释主动要求人类提供有针对性的纠正演示，以改善奖励恢复。
summary_zh: 从示范中学习奖励函数通常假设示范能够为所有特征——即行为中与任务相关的方面——提供充分的监督。然而在实践中，示范往往并不完美：人类可能因认知负荷或物理难度而弱化某些特征，或者训练过程可能未能充分覆盖所有相关情境。无论哪种情况，重要特征都可能出现说明不足的问题，导致学习到的奖励函数存在歧义，并在部署时产生行为偏差。我们提出了一种框架，用于检测这类说明不足的特征并主动寻求针对性的纠正示范。我们的关键洞见在于：示范隐式揭示了哪些特征得到了充分说明——持续优化的特征在示范中变化较小，而说明不足的特征则波动较大。我们利用这种统计信号推断哪些特征可能未被充分示范。随后，机器人以自然语言解释其不确定的特征，并请求提供能明确针对所识别缺失的示范。我们在模拟桌面操作领域以及基于真实Franka机器人的用户研究中评估了该方法。与随机查询和被动数据收集相比，具有解释引导的针对性查询显著提升了奖励函数的恢复效果，减少了因不完美示范而持续存在的歧义。

title: Dreaming Smoothly and Sample Efficiently with Gradient Penalized Latent Dynamics
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning improves sample efficiency by learning a world model. However, existing latent world models such as DreamerV3 do not explicitly enforce local smoothness in their learned transition dynamics, leaving a useful inductive bias for transition dynamics learning unexploited. We propose GPLD, a gradient-penalized latent dynamics regularizer for DreamerV3 that applies a row-wise Jacobian penalty to the posterior latent distribution to encourage locally smooth transition learning. We show that this penalty can be interpreted as the continuous-latent analog of finite-difference smoothing of transition laws in discrete embedded-state MDPs, and estimate it efficiently using Hutchinson-style stochastic probes. Empirically, across DeepMind Control proprioceptive tasks, GPLD improves aggregate sample efficiency, with particularly strong gains on higher-complexity locomotion environments. On more challenging quadruped tasks, GPLD reaches high-return behavior earlier and exhibits more consistent late-stage learning over longer horizons. Explicit local smoothness regularization is a simple and effective way to improve latent world models for smooth continuous control environments. Code for GPLD is available at github.com/romils9/gpld-mbrl .
tldr: GPLD introduces a gradient-penalized latent dynamics regularizer for DreamerV3 that enforces local smoothness in learned transition models, improving sample efficiency on continuous control tasks.
tldr_zh: GPLD 为 DreamerV3 引入梯度惩罚潜在动力学正则化器，强制学习过渡模型的局部平滑性，提高了连续控制任务的样本效率。
summary_zh: 基于模型的强化学习通过构建世界模型来提升样本效率。然而，现有潜在世界模型（如DreamerV3）并未在其学习的转移动力学中显式施加局部平滑性约束，导致这一对转移动力学学习有益的归纳偏置未被充分利用。我们提出GPLD——一种面向DreamerV3的梯度惩罚潜在动力学正则化器，通过对潜在后验分布施加逐行雅可比惩罚，以鼓励局部平滑的转移学习。研究表明，该惩罚可被解释为离散嵌入状态马尔可夫决策过程中转移规律有限差分平滑在连续潜在空间中的对应物，并可通过Hutchinson式随机探针高效估计。在DeepMind Control本体感受任务上的实验表明，GPLD提升了整体样本效率，尤其在复杂度较高的运动环境中表现突出。在更具挑战性的四足机器人任务中，GPLD能更早达到高回报行为，并在更长的时间跨度内展现出更稳定的后期学习表现。显式局部平滑正则化是改进面向平滑连续控制环境的潜在世界模型的简单有效手段。GPLD代码开源于github.com/romils9/gpld-mbrl。

title: Learning a Particle Dynamics Model with Real-world Videos
summary: Data-driven learning approaches for physics simulation, sometimes referred to as world models, have emerged as promising alternatives to traditional physics simulators due to their differentiable nature. Prior work has demonstrated impressive results in predicting the motions of rigid and non-rigid objects in complex scenes involving multiple interacting bodies. However, these models are typically trained in simulated environments because obtaining perfect state information such as complete scene point clouds and point correspondences over time is challenging in real-world settings. This reliance on synthetic data can limit their applicability when the sim-to-real gap is large. In this work, we aim to overcome these limitations by introducing a novel framework for training neural object dynamics models directly from unlabeled real-world videos. Specifically, we propose to learn a particle-based dynamics model compatible with a Gaussian splatting framework, which operates on dense particles derived from Gaussians (i.e., particles with scales and rotations) and predicts their position and rotation changes over time. The model is trained via rendering supervision, enabling learning from real-world videos without requiring particle-level labeled states. Our model operates directly on dense Gaussians without relying on heuristic subsampling anchor points. To enable this study, we also present a real-world dataset consisting of about 500 videos capturing diverse object interactions.
tldr: Proposes a framework to train a particle-based neural dynamics model directly from real-world videos using Gaussian splatting rendering supervision, eliminating the need for synthetic data and perfect state labels.
tldr_zh: 提出一个直接从真实视频中训练基于粒子的神经动力学模型的框架，利用高斯泼溅渲染监督，无需合成数据和完美状态标注。
summary_zh: 数据驱动的物理模拟学习方法（有时也称为世界模型）因其可微分的特性，已成为传统物理模拟器的有前景替代方案。已有研究在预测包含多个相互作用物体的复杂场景中刚性与非刚性物体运动方面展现了显著成果。然而，这类模型通常在模拟环境中训练，因为在真实场景中获取完整的场景点云及随时间变化的点对应关系等精确状态信息极具挑战性。这种对合成数据的依赖会限制模型在模拟环境与现实环境差距较大时的应用性。本研究旨在通过提出一种直接从无标注真实世界视频中训练神经物体动力学模型的新框架来突破这些限制。具体而言，我们提出学习一种兼容高斯泼溅框架的粒子基动力学模型，该模型对从高斯体导出的稠密粒子（即具有尺度和旋转参数的粒子）进行处理，并预测其位置与旋转随时间的演变。模型通过渲染监督进行训练，从而无需粒子级标注状态即可从真实视频中学习。该模型直接作用于稠密高斯体，无需依赖启发式亚采样锚点。为支撑本研究，我们还构建了一个包含约500段视频的真实世界数据集，这些视频记录了多样化的物体交互场景。

title: CRONOS: Benchmarking Counterfactual Physical Consistency in Video Models
summary: Video prediction is increasingly viewed as a path toward generalizable world models, yet it remains unclear whether these systems learn underlying causal structure or merely exploit superficial visual correlations for future prediction. We introduce CRONOS, an intervention-based benchmark designed to evaluate counterfactual physical consistency: whether a model's predictions of physical events respond appropriately to controlled changes in the visual input, such as variations of scene context, viewpoint, object appearance, and object category. Built in a photorealistic Unreal Engine environment, CRONOS enables controlled, high-fidelity generation of videos across diverse scenes and dynamics. In contrast to previous benchmarks, CRONOS systematically intervenes on four key factors - viewpoint, scene, object category, and object appearance - while keeping the underlying physical event type, such as a collision, occlusion, or fall, fixed. Our evaluation of recent open-source video generators reveals substantial failures in counterfactual physical consistency: prediction quality for the same physical event type is affected by appearance, environment, and, particularly by viewpoint changes. CRONOS provides a controlled and reproducible testbed for diagnosing how the quality of generated videos changes for different interventions, establishing a concrete target for developing models that perform consistently across changes of multiple conditions. The dataset and code are available at our project page.
tldr: CRONOS is an intervention-based benchmark for evaluating whether video prediction models capture counterfactual physical consistency by systematically varying viewpoint, scene, object category, and appearance while keeping physical events fixed, revealing substantial failures in current video generators.
tldr_zh: CRONOS是一个基于干预的基准测试，用于评估视频预测模型是否能够捕捉反事实物理一致性，通过系统性地改变视角、场景、物体类别和外观，同时保持物理事件固定，揭示了当前视频生成器的重大缺陷。
summary_zh: 视频预测日益被视为通往可泛化世界模型的一条路径，然而这些系统究竟是学习了潜在的因果结构，还是仅仅利用表面的视觉相关性进行未来预测，这一问题尚不明确。我们提出了CRONOS——一个基于干预的基准测试，旨在评估反事实物理一致性：即模型对物理事件的预测是否能够针对视觉输入中的可控变化（如场景背景、视角、物体外观及物体类别的变化）做出适当响应。CRONOS基于照片级真实的Unreal Engine环境构建，能够实现跨不同场景与动力学的可控、高保真视频生成。与以往的基准测试不同，CRONOS系统性地对四个关键因素——视角、场景、物体类别和物体外观——进行干预，同时保持潜在的物理事件类型（如碰撞、遮挡或下落）不变。我们对近期开源视频生成器的评估揭示了其在反事实物理一致性方面的严重缺陷：同一物理事件类型的预测质量受外观、环境、特别是视角变化的影响。CRONOS提供了一个可控且可复现的测试平台，用于诊断不同干预下生成视频质量的变化，为开发能够在多种条件变化下保持一致表现的模型确立了具体目标。数据集和代码可在我们的项目页面获取。

title: ComPose: When to Trust Hands for Object Pose Tracking
summary: Reconstructing the motion of objects from videos is a key component for embodied AI and robot manipulation. While diverse approaches to object pose tracking have been studied, they rely heavily on strong external priors, such as depth data or 3D templates, and remain highly vulnerable to severe occlusions by hand grasps despite the use of explicit masks. In this work, we present ComPose, a 6DoF object tracking framework designed for hand-aware object pose estimation from RGB video. Rather than treating the hand purely as an occluder, our method harmonizes hand motions as a \textit{complementary cue} for object tracking. In detail, we recover a variety of object motions over time by combining object and hand cues from foundation models within a unified tracking pipeline. Here, ComPose adaptively selects informative hand joints, combines object- and hand-derived cues for motion estimation, and refines the resulting object motion using visible geometric evidence and a learned correction. We further enforce the temporal consistency over both rotation and translation, yielding stable 3D object trajectories over time without any external smoothing. Extensive experiments show that our method is accurate, efficient, and robust under severe hand occlusion and geometric ambiguity. In addition, the resulting trajectories can also effectively transfer to downstream robot manipulation by enabling robots to reconstruct human actions from online videos.
tldr: ComPose is a 6DoF object tracking framework that uses hand motions as complementary cues rather than occluders, recovering object trajectories from RGB video with robustness to severe hand occlusion, and enabling transfer to downstream robot manipulation.
tldr_zh: ComPose是一个6DoF物体跟踪框架，将手的运动视为补充线索而非遮挡物，从RGB视频中恢复物体轨迹，对手部严重遮挡具有鲁棒性，并可迁移到下游机器人操作。
summary_zh: 从视频中重建物体运动是具身人工智能与机器人操作的关键组成部分。尽管已有多种物体姿态追踪方法被研究，但它们严重依赖深度数据或三维模板等强外部先验，且即便使用显式掩码，仍极易受到手部抓握造成的严重遮挡影响。本文提出ComPose——一种面向RGB视频的六自由度物体追踪框架，其设计目标为实现手部感知下的物体姿态估计。该方法并非将手部纯粹视为遮挡物，而是将手部运动协调为物体追踪的**互补线索**。具体而言，我们通过结合基础模型中的物体与手部线索，在统一追踪流程中恢复物体随时间变化的多种运动。在此框架下，ComPose自适应选择信息性手部关节点，融合源自物体与手部的线索进行运动估计，并利用可见几何证据与学习校正优化所得物体运动。我们进一步对旋转与平移施加时序一致性约束，无需任何外部平滑即可生成稳定的三维物体运动轨迹。大量实验表明，该方法在严重手部遮挡与几何歧义条件下展现出高精度、高效率与强鲁棒性。此外，所生成轨迹可通过使机器人从在线视频中重建人类动作，有效迁移至下游机器人操作任务。

title: Scene Reconstruction as Mapping Priors for 3D Detection
summary: In autonomous driving, mapping is critical for motion planning but remains an under-utilized resource for perception tasks such as 3D object detection. Maps can provide robust structural priors of the static environment, helping resolve ambiguities and correct for sensor data sparsity or noise, especially for distant objects or under adverse weather conditions. However, conventional High-Definition (HD) maps are resource-intensive to obtain and maintain, which presents a challenge for efficient, large-scale deployment. In this paper, we propose a scalable solution to systematically leverage mapping to improve 3D detection by overcoming two primary challenges. First, we introduce a pipeline to automatically build dense mapping priors from aggregated sensor data, eliminating the need for human labeling. Second, we design a novel Mapping Priors Augmented 3D Detection (MPA3D) framework to effectively integrate mapping priors with different sensor modalities. Extensive experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate that our approach achieves new state-of-the-art results, proving the effectiveness of scalable reconstructed scene priors for enhancing 3D detection.
tldr: Proposes a scalable pipeline to automatically build dense mapping priors from sensor data and a framework (MPA3D) integrating them with sensor modalities to improve 3D object detection for autonomous driving, achieving SOTA on Waymo.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种从传感器数据自动构建密集地图先验的管道，以及一个将其与传感器模态集成的框架（MPA3D），以改进自动驾驶中的3D物体检测，在Waymo上达到SOTA。
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶中，地图构建对运动规划至关重要，但在三维目标检测等感知任务中仍未被充分利用。地图能够提供静态环境的稳健结构先验，有助于解决歧义问题并修正传感器数据稀疏性或噪声带来的影响，尤其针对远距离目标或恶劣天气条件。然而，传统高清地图的获取与维护成本高昂，给高效大规模部署带来了挑战。本文提出一种可扩展的解决方案，通过克服两大主要挑战，系统性地利用地图构建来提升三维检测性能。首先，我们引入了一个流水线，可从聚合传感器数据中自动构建稠密的地图先验，无需人工标注。其次，我们设计了一种新颖的地图先验增强三维检测框架，能够有效融合地图先验与不同传感器模态。在Waymo开放数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法取得了新的最优结果，验证了可扩展重建场景先验在增强三维检测方面的有效性。

title: Vision-Based Agile Landing on Turbulent Waters
summary: Autonomous landing of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles on maritime vessels is challenging due to the coupled motion of the vehicle and landing platform in open-sea conditions. This paper presents a reinforcement-learning-based approach for autonomous multirotor landing on moving maritime platforms without requiring explicit platform-state information. The proposed method uses multirotor state measurements together with local visual features, consisting of keypoints and associated descriptors extracted from the landing surface, to predict attitude and thrust commands. These commands are tracked by a conventional low-level controller. The policy is trained in simulation using synthetic keypoints with randomly generated normalized descriptors, enabling zero-shot deployment with different local feature extractors onboard the UAV. We evaluate the method in a realistic simulator and show that it outperforms a state-of-the-art Model Predictive Control baseline under platform motions corresponding to ``Very Rough'' sea conditions. Finally, we perform extensive real-world experiments, demonstrating autonomous onboard landing using two different local feature extractors. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first approach for agile multirotor landing on maritime platforms in turbulent waters that does not rely on an explicit platform-state representation.
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement-learning approach for autonomous multirotor landing on moving maritime platforms using visual features without explicit platform-state information, demonstrating robust performance in turbulent waters in both simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的自主多旋翼无人机在移动海上平台降落的方法，仅利用视觉特征而无需显式的平台状态信息，在仿真和真实实验中均表现出在湍急水域中的鲁棒性能。
summary_zh: 无人飞行器在海上船舶上的自主降落具有挑战性，这是因为在公海条件下飞行器与降落平台存在耦合运动。本文提出一种基于强化学习的方法，用于实现多旋翼飞行器在移动海上平台上的自主降落，且无需显式的平台状态信息。该方法利用多旋翼状态测量值以及局部视觉特征（由降落表面提取的关键点及其关联描述符构成）来预测姿态和推力指令，这些指令由常规的低层控制器跟踪执行。策略在仿真环境中使用合成关键点及随机生成的归一化描述符进行训练，从而支持无人机搭载不同局部特征提取器时的零样本部署。我们在逼真的仿真器中对该方法进行了评估，结果表明，在对应“非常恶劣”海况的平台运动条件下，其性能优于最先进的模型预测控制基线方法。最后，我们开展了大量实世界实验，展示了使用两种不同局部特征提取器实现的自主机载降落。据我们所知，这是首个在湍流水域中实现多旋翼飞行器在海上平台敏捷降落且不依赖显式平台状态表达的方法。

title: 6G Communication Networks Enabling Embodied Agents: Architecture and Prototype
summary: Embodied agents, which couple intelligent decision-making with physical actuation in the real world, impose far more stringent and heterogeneous communication requirements than purely software-based agents. While 6G promises sub-millisecond latency, ultra-high reliability, native intelligence, and integrated sensing, systematic studies on how to exploit these capabilities for embodied agent communication remain limited. This article investigates 6G-enabled communication systems for embodied agents from both conceptual and engineering perspectives. First, we review the concept, embodiment value of embodied agents, and clarify their distinctions from disembodied agents. Then, we analyse the symbiotic relationship between embodied agents and 6G networks. We highlight how key 6G enablers can support the stringent requirements of human-robot interaction. Furthermore, we demonstrate the proactive role of embodied agents in bolstering communication networks through coverage extension, environmental sensing, and physical world understanding. Building on these insights, we propose a hierarchical communication architecture for human-robot remote interaction, comprising a human-intent perception layer, an open radio access network (O-RAN)-based transport layer, an intelligent intermediary layer, and an embodiment layer. To validate its feasibility, we implement an end-to-end prototype that integrates a haptic device, an industrial robotic arm, an intermediary platform, and a 5G O-RAN testbed. Experimental results demonstrate millisecond-level latency and stable closed-loop operation, confirming the practicality of the proposed architecture and providing a reference for future 6G-embodied agent research and industrial deployments.
tldr: This paper proposes a hierarchical communication architecture for embodied agents enabled by 6G networks, validates it with a prototype integrating haptic devices, robotic arms, and 5G O-RAN testbed, achieving millisecond-level latency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种由6G网络支持的具身智能体分层通信架构，并通过集成触觉设备、机械臂和5G O-RAN测试床的原型验证了其可行性，实现了毫秒级延迟。
summary_zh: 具身智能体将智能决策与现实世界的物理执行相结合，其通信需求相比纯软件智能体更为严苛且异质性更强。尽管6G承诺亚毫秒级时延、超高可靠性、原生智能与通感一体，但如何利用这些能力赋能具身智能体通信的系统性研究仍十分有限。本文从概念与工程双重视角探究面向具身智能体的6G通信系统：首先梳理具身智能体的概念与具身化价值，阐明其与非具身智能体的本质区别；继而分析具身智能体与6G网络的共生关系，揭示6G关键使能技术如何支撑人机交互的严苛需求，并论证具身智能体在扩展覆盖、环境感知与物理世界理解等方面对通信网络的反哺作用。基于上述认知，我们提出面向人机远程交互的分层通信架构，包含人类意图感知层、基于开放无线接入网（O-RAN）的传输层、智能中间层与具身层。为验证可行性，搭建了集成触觉设备、工业机械臂、中间平台与5G O-RAN试验床的端到端原型系统。实验结果表明，该系统可实现毫秒级时延与稳定闭环控制，验证了所提架构的实用性，为未来6G-具身智能体研究与产业部署提供了参考。

title: Four Simple Proprioceptive Estimators for Legged Robots
summary: Legged robots carry an IMU, but the inertial solution drifts because consumer-grade IMUs are noisy. However, the feet create intermittent contacts with the environment that can be used to mitigate that drift. This report develops a sequence of increasingly expressive legged robot state estimators that leverage this. In all cases, the floating-base state comprises attitude, position, velocity, and IMU biases. To model foot contacts, we start from the contact-aided invariant EKF of Hartley et al., albeit at a reduced contact update rate. This is then augmented by replacing the measurement update by a small factor graph. Finally, we turn the same factors into a fixed-lag smoother with contact-episode footholds, with and without an evolving IMU bias. To facilitate reproducibility and further research in proprioceptive legged odometry, all four variants are available in GTSAM (Dellaert et. al), and we additionally provide a ROS2-compatible implementation.
tldr: This paper presents four proprioceptive state estimators for legged robots, ranging from a contact-aided invariant EKF to a fixed-lag smoother, all using IMU data and foot contact information to reduce drift.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了四种用于腿式机器人的本体状态估计器，从接触辅助不变扩展卡尔曼滤波器到固定滞后平滑器，均利用IMU数据和足部接触信息来减少漂移。
summary_zh: 腿式机器人配备有惯性测量单元（IMU），但消费级IMU噪声较大，导致惯导解算存在漂移。然而，机器人足部与环境产生间歇性接触，可利用此类接触抑制漂移。本报告开发了一系列表达能力逐步增强的腿式机器人状态估计器，通过利用这一特性实现优化。所有方案中，浮动基座状态均包含姿态、位置、速度及IMU偏差。针对足部接触建模，我们从Hartley等人的接触辅助不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）方法出发，但降低了接触更新频率。随后，将测量更新替换为小型因子图，实现方法增强。最终，将这些因子转化为固定滞后平滑器，融入接触阶段的足端位置信息（考虑或不考虑IMU偏差的时变特性）。为促进本体感知腿式里程计的可复现性与后续研究，所有四种变体均已集成至GTSAM（Dellaert等人开发），并额外提供兼容ROS2的实现代码。

title: UfM*: Uncertainty from Motion* for DNN Depth Estimation Using Gaussians
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is critical for deploying monocular depth deep neural networks (DNNs) in safety-critical robotic systems. Conventional uncertainty methods such as ensembles and sampling-based approaches require multiple inferences per image, incurring substantial compute and memory overhead. Moreover, uncertainty predicted from a single image misses out on measuring disagreement between predictions across views of the same region. We propose Uncertainty from Motion* (UfM*), an uncertainty estimation algorithm that measures multiview disagreement efficiently by comparing previous and current views using a compact Gaussian mixture, requiring only a single DNN inference per image. Using Gaussians to compute multiview disagreement is not only more compute- and memory-efficient than a prior approach using a point cloud, but also improves uncertainty by measuring disagreement across regions of 3D space. UfM* paired with aleatoric uncertainty improves expected calibration error by 24-28% compared to an ensemble, while requiring only 3% of the energy and 0.02% of the memory on 100 out-of-distribution ScanNet sequences. We demonstrate UfM* consumes only 63 mJ per 224x224 image while running real-time at 30 FPS on an Arm Cortex-A76 CPU onboard a miniature energy-constrained robot, highlighting that measuring multiview disagreement using Gaussians enables efficient uncertainty for resource-constrained robotic systems.
tldr: Proposes an uncertainty estimation method for monocular depth DNNs that uses multiview disagreement with Gaussian mixtures, requiring only single inference per image and enabling real-time, low-power operation on resource-constrained robots.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于高斯混合的多视角不一致性深度不确定性估计方法，每张图像仅需单次推理，可在能耗受限的机器人上实现实时运行。
summary_zh: 可靠的 uncertainty（不确定性）估计对于在安全关键的机器人系统中部署单目深度神经网络（DNN）至关重要。传统的 uncertainty 方法，如集成法和基于采样的方法，需要对每张图像进行多次推理，从而带来大量计算和内存开销。此外，从单张图像预测的 uncertainty 无法测量同一区域不同视图间预测的分歧。我们提出基于运动的不确定性（UfM*），一种通过紧凑高斯混合模型比较前后视图来高效测量多视图分歧的 uncertainty 估计算法，每张图像仅需一次单次 DNN 推理。使用高斯模型计算多视图分歧不仅相比先前使用点云的方法在计算和内存上更高效，还能通过测量三维空间区域间的分歧来改进 uncertainty。与集成法相比，UfM* 结合偶然 uncertainty 可将期望校准误差降低 24-28%，而在 100 个分布外 ScanNet 序列上仅需 3% 的能量和 0.02% 的内存。我们证明，UfM* 在微型能量受限机器人的 Arm Cortex-A76 CPU 上以 30 FPS 实时运行时，每张 224x224 图像仅消耗 63 mJ，突显了使用高斯模型测量多视图分歧能够为资源受限的机器人系统实现高效的 uncertainty 估计。

title: Score-Based One-step MeanFlow Policy Optimization
summary: Diffusion and flow matching have emerged as expressive policy classes in reinforcement learning, but their reliance on multi-step denoising imposes substantial computational overhead at inference time, which is particularly problematic in online RL. MeanFlow offers a promising alternative by learning an average velocity field that maps noise to data in a single network evaluation. However, MeanFlow typically requires samples from the target distribution to construct its target velocity field, which are unavailable in online RL. We propose Score-Based One-step MeanFlow Policy Optimization (SOM), an actor-critic algorithm that resolves this by constructing the target velocity field directly from the Q-function via score estimation and a probability flow ODE, thereby concentrating probability mass on high-value modes. In the fully online RL setting, SOM achieves state-of-the-art performance on locomotion tasks with a single generation step, while substantially reducing both training and inference time compared to prior diffusion- and flow-matching-based policies.
tldr: Proposes SOM, an actor-critic algorithm that constructs a target velocity field from the Q-function via score estimation, enabling one-step policy generation in online RL with state-of-the-art locomotion performance and reduced compute.
tldr_zh: 提出SOM算法，通过得分估计从Q函数构建目标速度场，实现在线RL中的单步策略生成，在运动控制任务上达到最优性能并降低计算开销。
summary_zh: 扩散与流匹配已成为强化学习中具有表现力的策略类别，但其对多步去噪过程的依赖在推理阶段带来显著计算开销，这在在线强化学习中尤为棘手。均值流通过学习将噪声映射到数据的平均速度场（仅需单次网络评估）提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，均值流通常需要目标分布的样本来构建其目标速度场，这在在线强化学习中无法实现。我们提出基于分数的单步均值流策略优化（SOM），这是一种演员-评论家算法，通过评分估计和概率流常微分方程直接从Q函数构建目标速度场，从而将概率质量集中于高价值模式。在完全在线强化学习场景中，SOM在仅需单步生成的情况下实现了运动控制任务的最优性能，同时相比先前基于扩散和流匹配的策略，显著降低了训练与推理时间。

title: GFSR: Geometric Fidelity and Spatial Refinement for Reliable Lane Detection
summary: Lane detection stands as a crucial perception task in autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. However, existing methods still degrade in complex real scenarios due to two major limitations. First, classification confidence only characterizes the categorical existence of lane candidates and has no strong correlation with geometric quality. If threshold filtering and NMS are conducted merely based on this confidence, the model tends to retain lane priors with high confidence while eliminating those with lower confidence but superior geometric representation. Secondly, existing regression modules weaken correlations among sampling points, hindering fine-grained optimization of distant, high-curvature and complex-topology lanes and causing underfitting. To address these issues, we propose Geometric Fidelity and Spatial Refinement (GFSR), a framework consisting of LaneIoU-guided Confidence Calibration (LCC) and Adaptive Gated Location Refinement (AGLR). Specifically, LCC adopts LaneIoU as soft supervision to explicitly estimate geometric fidelity of lane priors, which is further fused with classification confidence to construct the collaborative reliability index (CRI). This index guides threshold filtering and NMS, effectively retaining lane priors with high classification confidence and favorable geometric quality. Meanwhile, cooperating with regression heads in each refinement stage, AGLR predicts sampling point lateral offsets and adopts a gating mechanism to adaptively regulate correction magnitude, strengthen inter-point correlations and boost model adaptability as well as robustness toward complex lane scenarios. Extensive experiments on CULane and CurveLanes demonstrate that our GFSR achieves state-of-the-art performance on CULane, with F1@50 and F1@75 scores of 81.46% and 65.01%, and reaches 87.35% F1@50 on CurveLanes.
tldr: GFSR improves lane detection by calibrating confidence based on geometric fidelity and refining spatial correlation among sampling points, achieving SOTA on CULane and CurveLanes.
tldr_zh: GFSR 通过基于几何保真度的置信度校准和增强采样点空间关联的细化模块，提升车道检测性能，在 CULane 和 CurveLanes 上达到最优。
summary_zh: 车道检测是自动驾驶及高级驾驶辅助系统中的关键感知任务。然而，现有方法在复杂真实场景中仍存在性能退化问题，主要受限于两大因素。首先，分类置信度仅表征车道候选目标的类别存在性，与几何质量无强相关性。若仅基于该置信度进行阈值过滤与非极大值抑制，模型倾向于保留高置信度的车道先验，而剔除置信度较低但几何表征更优的样本。其次，现有回归模块弱化采样点间的相关性，阻碍了对远距离、高曲率及复杂拓扑结构车道的细粒度优化，导致欠拟合。针对上述问题，我们提出几何保真与空间精炼框架（GFSR），该框架包含车道交并比引导的置信度校准模块（LCC）与自适应门控位置精炼模块（AGLR）。具体而言，LCC采用LaneIoU作为软监督信号显式评估车道先验的几何保真度，并将其与分类置信度融合构建协同可靠度指数（CRI）。该指数指导阈值过滤与NMS操作，有效保留兼具高分类置信度与优良几何质量的车道先验。同时，AGLR在各精炼阶段与回归头协同工作，预测采样点横向偏移量，并采用门控机制自适应调控修正幅度，增强点间相关性，提升模型对复杂车道场景的适应能力与鲁棒性。在CULane与CurveLanes数据集上的大量实验表明，本框架在CULane上以81.46%的F1@50与65.01%的F1@75分数达到最优性能，并在CurveLanes上取得87.35%的F1@50分数。

title: SFG-ROS: A Resource-Aware Framework for Dense Multi-Agent Perception
summary: Deploying heterogeneous multi-agent robot fleets for collaborative perception requires robust data exchange and scalable software architectures. However, standard ROS 2 implementations often suffer from network saturation, namespace collisions, and severe computational overhead when distributing dense sensor streams across devices. To address these bottlenecks, we present SFG-ROS, a resource-aware multi-agent software framework designed for dynamic fleet deployments. SFG-ROS addresses these challenges through three primary contributions. First, schema-driven traffic routing isolates high-frequency intra-agent traffic from the global network using a programmatic fully qualified name schema and targeted Fast DDS routing. Second, an on-demand centralized decoding pipeline automatically offloads high-bandwidth sensor data decompression, eliminating redundant processing across local consumer nodes. Finally, a hardware-agnostic container pipeline dynamically adapts to heterogeneous accelerators, seamlessly bridging development environments with zero-touch, field-ready execution. We evaluate the framework using a fleet of wheeled and legged robots equipped with LiDAR and stereo depth cameras. Experimental results show SFG-ROS bounds network traffic to $\mathcal{O}(1)$ and, by replacing redundant decompression with lightweight IPC, reduces the per-subscriber CPU scaling penalty by 72.3\% versus standard ROS 2, all while maintaining low latency. Finally, we publish SFG-ROS under a permissive license, available via \href{https://iis-esslingen.github.io/sfg-ros}{iis-esslingen.github.io/sfg-ros}.
tldr: SFG-ROS is a resource-aware ROS 2 framework for dense multi-agent perception that uses schema-driven traffic routing, on-demand centralized decoding, and a hardware-agnostic container pipeline to reduce network saturation and CPU overhead across heterogeneous robot fleets.
tldr_zh: SFG-ROS 是一个面向密集多智能体感知的资源感知型 ROS 2 框架，通过模式驱动的流量路由、按需集中解码和硬件无关的容器管道，降低了异构机器人集群的网络饱和与 CPU 开销。

title: How Many Training Samples Are Needed for the Inverse Kinematics Solutions by Artificial Neural Networks
summary: Inverse Kinematics (IK) plays a critical role in robotic motion planning and control. The IK solutions of a robot manipulator could be done by conventional ways such as geometric, algebraic, or Jacobian methods, which have drawbacks. The Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) have become a promising alternative for approximating IK solutions due to their generalization ability and computational efficiency. This approach basically trains only a few samples of the end effector that are recorded for the solution of the IK problem. However, a fundamental question remains: how many training samples are sufficient to achieve reliable and accurate IK predictions? This study investigates the mathematical framework of relating the size of training datasets and the accuracy of ANN-based IK solvers. Using an articulated robotic manipulator, we generate varying amounts of joint-position pairs to train feedforward neural networks and assess their accuracy, convergence, and generalization capability. The results reveal more training samples than 125 did not contribute to the improvement of the model efficiency that the comparable measure dealing with the approximation accuracy over the sampling size, offering valuable insight into data efficiency. This work provides practical guidance for optimizing the data sizing of ANN solutions, balancing computational cost and model accuracy for real-world robotic applications.
tldr: This paper empirically investigates the relationship between training dataset size and accuracy for ANN-based inverse kinematics solvers on an articulated manipulator, finding that beyond 125 samples yields diminishing returns.
tldr_zh: 本文实验研究了人工神经网络逆运动学求解器的训练数据集大小与精度之间的关系，发现在超过125个样本后收益递减。

title: Droneulator: A Portable UAV Simulator for Agricultural Workflows with RotorPy and Godot 4
summary: Agricultural UAV research requires simulators that integrate realistic 3D scenes, high-fidelity vehicle dynamics, and robotics middleware, while remaining practical to deploy across heterogeneous development machines. We present Droneulator, a portable UAV simulator architecture that combines RotorPy for multirotor dynamics with Godot 4 for rendering and sensor generation. Droneulator exposes both PX4-based control and a lightweight WebSocket command path, and publishes synchronised visual and state streams through a Zenoh-based ROS~2-compatible pipeline. This integration enables a single stack to support inspection-oriented data capture, ROS~2/PX4 local planning, and reinforcement learning experiments without modifying the simulator infrastructure. We present quantified validation of the current system across three agricultural UAV workflows: tree-scale image collection for 3D reconstruction with COLMAP, local planning around canopy obstacles using EGO-Planner, and closed-loop reinforcement learning through a custom Gymnasium environment. In the reported setup, the results show that the simulator can sustain low-latency sensing, support reconstruction-oriented data collection under varying capture density, execute collision-free local planning around canopy obstacles, and support stable depth-sensing-based policy training for obstacle-aware navigation. Together, these results show the potential of Droneulator for agricultural UAV inspection, planning, and learning within one deployable stack.
tldr: Droneulator integrates RotorPy dynamics with Godot 4 rendering and Zenoh/ROS2 middleware to provide a portable UAV simulator supporting inspection, planning, and reinforcement learning workflows for agricultural tasks.
tldr_zh: Droneulator 结合 RotorPy 动力学、Godot 4 渲染和 Zenoh/ROS2 中间件，提供一个便携式无人机模拟器，支持农业场景中的检测、规划和强化学习工作流。

title: Multi-Floor Exploration for Ground Robots via an Incremental Reachable Graph and Structural Priors
summary: Autonomous exploration of multi-floor buildings remains challenging for ground robots because conventional 2D and 2.5D maps cannot represent overlapping traversable surfaces such as stairs, ramps, and multiple reachable elevations. This letter presents a multi-floor exploration framework based on an incremental reachable graph. Built as a sparse graph over reachable support surfaces, the graph preserves potentially valid connectivity through tentative graph elements under sparse observations and enables stable, physically reachable frontier detection. To guide exploration beyond the currently mapped floor, we project task-zone priors from an explored floor to initialize a hypothetical graph on the target floor and reconcile it incrementally with incoming observations. A hierarchical planner then jointly reasons over confirmed and hypothetical structures for global guidance. In simulation, the proposed method demonstrates improved exploration efficiency and mapping completeness compared to evaluated baselines. Furthermore, onboard real-world experiments validate its practical feasibility and real-time performance.
tldr: A multi-floor exploration framework for ground robots using an incremental reachable graph, structural priors, and hierarchical planning to improve efficiency and mapping completeness.
tldr_zh: 一种基于增量可达图与结构先验的多楼层地面机器人自主探索框架，通过层级规划提升探索效率与地图完整性。

title: Signal Temporal Logic Motion Planning via Graphs of Convex Sets
summary: This paper investigates continuous-time motion planning under Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications. The goal is to generate smooth robot trajectories that satisfy high-level logical and timing requirements while respecting low-level motion constraints. To this end, we propose an efficient framework that combines timed-automata reasoning with graphs of convex sets (GCS). An STL specification is first represented by a timed automaton, which is then coupled with a convex decomposition of the configuration space to form a joint transition system encoding both task progress and region occupancy. Based on this joint transition system, the STL motion-planning problem is reformulated as a shortest-path problem over a GCS, whose solution induces a smooth Bézier-spline trajectory satisfying the STL specification, smoothness requirements, and velocity bounds. We establish the soundness of the proposed formulation and analyze its computational complexity, showing that, once the timed automaton and convex decomposition are fixed, the convex relaxation scales polynomially with the configuration-space dimension and the Bézier degree. We further develop a compact timed-automaton construction for an expressive STL fragment using dedicated templates and Boolean composition. Numerical experiments on low-dimensional benchmarks, a $3$-D quadrotor, a $30$-DoF humanoid, and a hardware experiment on a UR-3 robot arm demonstrate that the proposed method efficiently solves complex STL motion-planning problems and produces smooth executable trajectories.
tldr: This paper proposes a framework that combines timed-automata reasoning with graphs of convex sets to generate smooth robot trajectories satisfying Signal Temporal Logic specifications, with hardware validation on a UR-3 arm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合时间自动机推理与凸集图的框架，用于生成满足信号时序逻辑规范的平滑机器人轨迹，并在UR-3机械臂上进行了硬件验证。

title: Lipschitz Optimization for Formal Verification of Homographies
summary: The adoption of vision neural networks in regulated industries requires formal robustness guarantees, especially in safety-critical domains such as healthcare, autonomous vehicles, and aerospace. However, current approaches are confined to incomplete statistical verification or robustness to $\ell_p$-norm and affine transforms, which cover only a narrow subset of perturbations to the image formation process. In particular, robustness to camera motion remains an open problem despite being key to deploy many vision applications. We present a formal verification approach that targets robustness against 3D motion perturbations of the capturing camera. We first establish a closed-form mapping from camera pose to pixel values. By analyzing the continuity properties of the resulting homographies, we show that recent work on Lipschitz optimization and piecewise continuity can be extended to derive tight linear bounds on perturbed pixel values. Our approach applies to scenes with predominantly planar structure, such as ground planes in augmented reality, road markings and traffic signs in autonomous driving, or planar workspaces in robotic manipulation. This enables the first formal verification of projective geometry transforms, without complex simulation, surrogate networks, or explicit image-formation models. We validate our implementation and show up to 89% speedup and 7% tighter bounds over prior work. We then evaluate our method on the VNN-COMP benchmark and reveal systematic weaknesses to projective perturbations.
